content.title: The 25th Amendment - YouTube
content.text: The 25th Amendment describes the procedure for when a president or vice president dies or is unable to fulfill their duties. It seems like a mundane part of the Constitution, but it has been used many times since its ratification in 1967. 60-Second Civics, Episode 5307: February 10, 2025 (a rebroadcast of Episode 5057: January 25, 2024) Subscribe and take the Daily Civics Quiz at http://civiced.org/60-second-civics The show’s theme song is “Complacent” by Cheryl B.
